evidence: Since its establishment in 1969, this revered institution has been a beacon of artistic excellence, drawing visitors from around the globe to witness the enchanting performances that blend traditional puppetry with the vibrant energy of contemporary urban life. The theatre, located on Dinh Tien Hoang Street, is named after the ancient capital of Thang Long, a moniker that echoes the grandeur of the Ly Dynasty when King Ly Thai To relocated the capital here in the early 11th century.
